questions.markdown:
Solve the problem of sorting one-dimensional array using a C program. Write a C program that reads integers from the keyboard and places them in an array. The program then sorts the array into ascending and descending order and prints the sorted lists. The program must not change the original array or create any other integer arrays.

[Hint: Use array of pointers]
Solve the computation of $X^Y$ using C program which uses recursive function.

One of the important applications that can be implemented using queues is priority job scheduling. Solve the problem of priority job scheduling using a priority queue in which the empty position in the queue (created when the job is removed based on the priority) is indicated by a 'special indicator' so that a new job can be placed in the first empty position.

Apply the postfix expression evaluation algorithm for the following expression:

$A\ B\ C\ *\ D\ +\ C\ /\ -$

Show the contents of the given table after every operation. (Consider: A=9; B=3; C=4; D=8)

Assume that an array dequeue[$MAX$] is used to represent an input restricted dequeue. Build C functions to implement Insertion at right end of dequeue, deletion from left end of dequeue and deletion from right end of dequeue. Assume the following initial conditions for required variables where $MAX$ is maximum size of the array, left and right are the variables which point to left and right end of the dequeue, respectively.

```c
#define MAX 10
int dequeue [MAX], left=-1, right=-1;
```
